verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own developer docs list a 'Sending SMS' guide and describe programmable SMS/MMS APIs, plus a general event notifications and subscriptions framework, so outbound SMS via the API is directly evidenced. The pack never ties those notifications to inbound messages or delivery status. missing for 10: documented inbound SMS receipt via the API, SMS delivery-status callbacks or webhooks specifically, depth of documentation beyond page titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks

citations.quote: RingCentral provides a suite of powerful APIs for voice, SMS/MMS, team messaging, video, fax, data management and system configuration.
Introduction to event notifications and subscriptions
